datasets.title: The Homunculus, ultraviolet to visible
datasets.description: ESA/Hubble's picture of the Homunculus Nebula, at 220, 250, 330, 550 and 660 nm: dust lit by the star Eta Carinae inside it. It lies on the surface Steffen et al. (2014) made from spectra of the whole nebula: two hollow lobes, their pole 41° from the sight line (Smith 2006), the south-east one tipped toward the Sun. The picture is on the side of each lobe that faces the Sun; the other sides, which no one has photographed, repeat it.
datasets.summary: Hubble's picture on the nebula's published 3D surface: two closed lobes, their pole 41° from the sight line.
